faq_heading: Chilliwack Mountain condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 18 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Mountain between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $688,450.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Chilliwack Mountain?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Mountain sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 18 townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Mountain went for between $660,625 and $731,250, around a median of $688,450.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Mountain sell above asking price?
faq.a: 0% of the 18 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.9% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Mountain?
faq.a: Of the 18 sales, 18 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $395.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Mountain?
faq.a: The median year built was 2014 for the 18 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Mountain.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Mountain usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Chilliwack Mountain had 3 bedrooms, from the 18 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Mountain condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

18 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Mountain with a median price of $688,450 (the middle half sold between $660,625 and $731,250), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $327 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median strata fee of $395 a month.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Mountain compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median townhome in Chilliwack Mountain sold for $688,450, 20% above the Chilliwack median of $572,500 across 108 sales. Chilliwack Mountain townhomes took a median 26 days to sell, against 29 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
